metadata.title: perf: Add nginx caching for admin pages with multi-tenant isolation #1946
metadata.author: crivetimihai

description:
## Summary

Enable short-TTL (5s) caching for admin pages to reduce CPU load from Jinja2 template rendering under high concurrency.

## Security Measures

Multi-tenant safety is ensured through:

| Measure | Implementation |
|---------|---------------|
| Per-user cache isolation | Cache key includes `$http_authorization`, `$cookie_jwt_token`, `$cookie_access_token` |
| Prevent CDN/proxy caching | `Cache-Control: private` header |
| Handle JWT refresh cookies | `proxy_ignore_headers Set-Cookie` (safe: 5s TTL, read-only GETs) |

## Performance Impact (4000 concurrent users)

| Metric | Before | After | Improvement |
|--------|--------|-------|-------------|
| `/admin/` response time | 5414ms | 199ms | 96% |
| Throughput | ~2400 RPS | ~4000 RPS | 67% |

## Verification

Tested multi-tenant isolation:
```
User A - Request 1: MISS (cache populated)
User A - Request 2: HIT (user's cache)
User B - Request 1: MISS (different session = new cache entry)
User B - Request 2: HIT (user's cache)
User A - Request 3: HIT (still isolated)
```

Closes #1946

commits.message:
perf: Add nginx caching for admin pages with multi-tenant isolation

Enable short-TTL (5s) caching for admin pages to reduce CPU load from
Jinja2 template rendering under high concurrency.

Security measures for multi-tenant safety:
- Cache key includes all auth methods ($http_authorization,
  $cookie_jwt_token, $cookie_access_token) to isolate users
- Cache-Control: private prevents shared caches (CDNs/proxies)
  from storing user-specific content
- Set-Cookie header ignored for cache decisions (safe due to
  short TTL and read-only GET requests)

Performance impact (4000 concurrent users):
- /admin/ response time: 5414ms → 199ms (96% improvement)
- Throughput: ~2400 → ~4000 RPS (67% improvement)

Closes #1946

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
